cases.name: young-reference-through-uninstrumented-closure
cases.trigger: A mature closure receives a young object through an unclassified lvalue
cases.requiredJudgment: Reject writer closure; no young space reuse while the edge is unaccounted
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: remember-reset-redirty
cases.trigger: A source card is reset while a next-epoch producer dirties it
cases.requiredJudgment: Freeze/drain or version the reset; preserve both epoch obligations
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: forwarding-before-body-ready
cases.trigger: A second worker reads a claimed destination before copy completion
cases.requiredJudgment: Keep claimed versus complete states distinct; do not trace incomplete fields
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: promotion-reserve-and-restore
cases.trigger: Workers have local destination chunks but contexts lack valid resume leases
cases.requiredJudgment: Fail capacity admission without recycling source or invalidating published destinations
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: root-removal-during-mark
cases.trigger: The last snapshot reference is removed through a native RootSlot unlink
cases.requiredJudgment: Retain/log its mature referent and cell reader lifetime before removal completes
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: new-mature-object-strong-and-weak-slots
cases.trigger: A new mature object contains a mature strong referent and a typed weak referent
cases.requiredJudgment: Shade strong referent at publication; route weak edge only through declared weak semantics
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: log-overflow-before-overwrite
cases.trigger: A store requires SATB logging but its native log is full
cases.requiredJudgment: Take protected slow path before overwrite, reload after safepoint and retry in current epoch
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: major-worker-crosses-minor-cut
cases.trigger: A major worker keeps a raw young borrow while nursery pages are recycled
cases.requiredJudgment: Block cut completion until worker parks without such a borrow and promotion work is handed off
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: continuation-replay-and-code-lifetime
cases.trigger: A captured continuation is invoked twice across a major epoch/module retirement
cases.requiredJudgment: Rebind activation roots/epoch/leases for each invocation and retain code/maps until last user
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: nonzero-rc-and-marker-allocation
cases.trigger: Native registration uses a nonzero owner and marker creation can allocate
cases.requiredJudgment: Require actual caller scan closure and proc protection before allocation; do not infer a reproduced current crash
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: late-release-producer-at-shutdown
cases.trigger: A dead foreign wrapper schedules a derived owner-affine cleanup after a queue empties
cases.requiredJudgment: Account producer/derived-task custody and hold root/code/VM until acknowledged drain
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness

cases.name: negative-work-and-language-net
cases.trigger: High survival, many roots and mutations outweigh avoided copying; Zig support equals or exceeds funded C cost
cases.requiredJudgment: Reject positive runtime-work and/or Zig-increment bound independently
cases.status: unevaluated design case; no native/model witness
